LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive 10x10 waffle chart powered by D3.js — shows part-to-whole proportions as filled grid cells with aggregation and drill-down support.

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Group By Field
property.description: API name of the category field (e.g., StageName)

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate (not required for Count)

property.name: operation
property.label: Aggregation
property.description: How to aggregate the values. On the GraphQL self-fetch path, Count is bounded to the first Record Limit rows (default 2000).

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object to query. When set (and no records are passed in), the chart self-fetches this object via GraphQL. Also used for drill-down navigation on cell click.

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Group By Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: graphqlQuery
property.label: GraphQL Query
property.description: Optional override of the built query. Must be a UI API record query (uiapi.query) whose node selects the Group By Field and Value Field as top-level fields; the returned rows are aggregated client-side by Group By Field / Value Field / Aggregation. UI-API-queryable objects only; at most 2,000 records; GraphQL syntax. Footgun: if the Value Field is missing from the query, cells aggregate to zero rather than erroring. Leave blank to build the query automatically.

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Record Type
propertyType.description: Generic sObject type of the input record collection

property.name: recordCollection
property.label: Records
property.description: Collection of records to chart, from the flow

property.description: API name of the category field

property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate (not required for Count)
